read.thesis: Q2 CY26 revenue NT$1,270bn (+36% YoY, +12% QoQ) with 67.7% gross margin; Q3 guided to US$44.6–45.8bn and 65–67% gross margin, implying continued demand strength with no capacity-discipline disclosure in this release.

triggers.label: Q3 revenue guided US$44.6–45.8bn
triggers.quote: Revenue is expected to be between US$44.6 billion and US$45.8 billion

triggers.label: 2nm ramp at 3% of wafer revenue
triggers.quote: shipments of 2-nanometer accounted for 3% of total wafer revenue

triggers.label: Gross margin 67.7% in Q2
triggers.quote: Gross margin for the quarter was 67.7%

guidance.quote: Revenue is expected to be between US$44.6 billion and US$45.8 billion
Gross profit margin is expected to be between 65% and 67%
Operating profit margin is expected to be between 56% and 58%
